description:
As a customer, I want to complete my order.

* The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

criteria.text: The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

cases.title: Customer finishes checkout and sees a confirmation
cases.preconditions: A customer account exists and is logged in; the customer has at least one item in the cart and is able to reach the checkout flow.
steps: Open the cart and start the checkout flow.
Complete each step of the checkout flow with valid data until the final step is reached.
Submit the order from the final checkout step.
cases.expected: Checkout completes and a confirmation is shown to the user. The exact content, wording and layout of the confirmation are not specified in the story.
